es: Presentar una propuesta completa para un evento del barrio (objetivo, beneficio, plan con fechas y petición) y responder a objeciones con un plan.

teaching.en: Admittedly, the budget is tight, but we have a fallback plan.
teaching.es: Es cierto que el presupuesto es ajustado, pero tenemos un plan de reserva.
teaching.explanationEs: Admittedly reconoce el punto débil antes de responder.
segments: Admittedly, the budget is tight, but
teaching.audioText: Admittedly, the budget is tight, but we have a fallback plan.

teaching.en: I understand your concern about noise, and I would like to address it directly.
teaching.es: Entiendo tu preocupación por el ruido y quiero atenderla directamente.
teaching.explanationEs: Concern + address: muestras que escuchaste y prometes responder.
segments: I understand your concern about noise, and
I would like to address it directly.
teaching.audioText: I understand your concern about noise, and I would like to address it directly.

teaching.en: That is a fair objection, but the festival will end at ten, so the noise will stop early.
teaching.es: Es una objeción razonable, pero el festival terminará a las diez y el ruido cesará pronto.
teaching.explanationEs: Reconoces la objeción y respondes con un hecho concreto.
segments: That is a fair objection, but the festival will
end at ten, so the noise will stop early.
teaching.audioText: That is a fair objection, but the festival will end at ten, so the noise will stop early.

teaching.en: To reassure every resident, we will have cleaned the square by midnight.
teaching.es: Para tranquilizar a cada vecino, habremos limpiado la plaza antes de medianoche.
teaching.explanationEs: Reassure + persona, sin to; se combina con los futuros del calendario.
segments: To reassure every resident, we will
have cleaned the square by midnight.
teaching.audioText: To reassure every resident, we will have cleaned the square by midnight.

teaching.en: If you approve our proposal today, we will be advertising the event by May.
teaching.es: Si aprueban nuestra propuesta hoy, para mayo ya estaremos promocionando el evento.
teaching.explanationEs: Cierre con condición y futuro: une la petición con el calendario.
segments: If you approve our proposal today, we
will be advertising the event by May.
teaching.audioText: If you approve our proposal today, we will be advertising the event by May.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta reconoce la objeción y propone una solución?

choices.text: That is not true, so we will not change anything.
That is a fair point, but we will stop the music at ten.
Nobody has complained before, so relax.

feedback.es: Una buena respuesta reconoce la duda (fair point) y ofrece un plan concreto.

hint.es: Busca la que admite la duda y propone un hecho.

prompt.es: Completa: «Es una objeción razonable, pero hay un plan de reserva.»

feedback.es: Fallback plan es el plan B que cubre el riesgo señalado.

hint.es: Es el nombre del plan B, en una sola palabra.

origin.text: That is a fair objection, but we have a ___ plan.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Para tranquilizar a los vecinos, limpiaremos la plaza.»

answer.text: To reassure the residents we will clean the square

feedback.es: To reassure + personas abre el propósito; después va el plan concreto.

hint.es: Empieza con To y termina con el lugar que se limpia.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta atiende mejor la objeción de este vecino?

choices.text: The square is already dirty, so it does not matter.
Please do not worry about the square.
We understand the concern and will have cleaned the square by midnight.

feedback.es: La mejor respuesta muestra comprensión y compromete una acción con fecha.

origin.text: Objection: «Your festival will leave the square dirty.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo responde la oradora a la duda sobre el dinero.

choices.text: She reduces the cost and asks for extra funding.
She asks the residents for money.

feedback.es: Reduce el gasto a 2.000 dólares y pide una subvención para el resto.

origin.audio: Admittedly, the budget is tight. However, we will allocate only 2,000 dollars and ask the council for a grant to cover the rest.

prompt.es: Completa las tres frases de una respuesta a una objeción.

feedback.es: Concern nombra la preocupación, address la atiende y recommend that pide la forma base approve.

sentences: I understand your ___ about the traffic.
We would like to ___ it directly.
We recommend that the council ___ the plan.

prompt.es: ¿Qué parte de la propuesta es esta frase?

feedback.es: «We request a grant…» es la petición: dice qué se pide y a quién.

origin.text: We request a grant of 3,000 dollars to buy lights for the street.

prompt.es: Completa (forma base): «Insistimos en que el escenario sea inspeccionado.»

feedback.es: Insist that pide forma base: be inspected.

origin.text: We insist that the stage ___ inspected before the gates open.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cuál es el punto débil del plan.

choices.text: It has no plan B if the council says no.

feedback.es: El plan depende de que el consejo pague y no tiene alternativa si no lo hace.

origin.audio: The plan is feasible, but it rests on one assumption: that the council will pay. If it does not, there is no fallback, and the volunteers will have to pay for the posters.

prompt.es: Escribe una propuesta para un trueque de ropa de invierno y responde a una objeción.

answer.text: The objective of this proposal is to organise a winter clothes swap in the square on 14 November. The main benefit is that families will save money and reduce waste. We recommend that the council approve the square for one afternoon, and we request a grant of 500 dollars for tables and posters. By 1 November we will have printed the posters, and within two weeks we will be advertising the swap in schools and shops. Admittedly, some neighbours may worry about noise and litter. That is a fair objection, but the swap will end at five, and we will have cleaned the square before the evening. To reassure every resident, we also have a fallback plan in case of rain: the school hall. We are sure that this swap will bring neighbours together, and we would be very grateful if the council could approve it soon.
accepted: The objective of this proposal is to organise a winter clothes swap in the square on 14 November. The main benefit is that families will save money and reduce waste. That is a fair objection, but the swap will end at five, and we will have cleaned the square before the evening. To reassure every resident, we also have a fallback plan in case of rain: the school hall. We are sure that this swap will bring neighbours together, and we would be very grateful if the council could approve it soon.

Our objective is to hold a clothes swap for winter in the main square. The benefit is clear: families will save money and everybody will throw away less. We suggest that the council approve the square for one afternoon, and we request a grant of 500 dollars. No later than 1 November we will have printed the posters, and within a month we will be advertising the event. I understand your concern about noise. That is a fair point, so we propose that the swap finish at five, and we will have cleaned everything by six. If it rains, our fallback plan is the school hall. We believe that the swap will be useful for families, and we would like to start as soon as possible.

feedback.es: Una propuesta completa enlaza objetivo, beneficio, recomendación con that, fechas, petición y una respuesta concreta a la objeción.

origin.text: Escribe en inglés una propuesta de 130 a 260 palabras para un mercado de trueque de ropa de invierno en tu barrio (14 de noviembre, en la plaza). Incluye objetivo, un beneficio, una recomendación con that, un hito con fecha y una petición. Después responde a esta objeción: «Habrá mucho ruido y nadie limpiará después».

choices.text: It is unrealistic for two volunteers to do so much in one afternoon.

feedback.es: Dos voluntarios no pueden construir el escenario e imprimir todos los carteles en una tarde: es poco realista.

origin.text: Plan: We will build the stage and print all the posters in the same afternoon, with two volunteers.

origin.text: The ___ of this proposal is to reduce waste in the neighbourhood.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada palabra con su significado.

feedback.es: Admittedly reconoce un punto débil, concern nombra la duda, fallback es el plan B y reassure calma a alguien.
